about: compiler/pinset: pinned toolchain lock parsing, Key.Name hashing, USTAR tar.gz bundling, digest verification, and fs.Writes installation (SELFHOST-LEDGER-RECEIPT).

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-pin-digest-length
mutants.rule: IsDigest must reject strings whose length is not 64 hex characters.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-pin-key-level
mutants.rule: KeyName must include non-empty architecture level components in the bundle stem.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-pin-lock-set-line
mutants.rule: ParseLock must record set <name> <digest> lines into the PinTable.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-pin-tar-digest-check
mutants.rule: VerifyAndUnpackBundle must fail when the uncompressed tar SHA-256 differs from expectedTarDigest.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-pin-index-digest-check
mutants.rule: ParseIndex must validate every entry digest with IsDigest.

mutants.name: selfhost-ledger-pin-install-verified-flag
mutants.rule: InstallLockedBundle must mark a verified and installed bundle row with SetVerified = true.
